question_cn: A 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group A?
one_liner_cn: 墨西哥坐拥三场本土高原比赛、Elo 与近期状态全面领先，约 77% 概率拿下 A 组头名；韩国与捷克之间的差距小于一场比赛的偶然性，南非仅剩数学可能。
one_liner_en: With all three group games on home altitude soil and a clear lead in Elo and form, Mexico wins Group A about 77% of the time; the South Korea-Czechia gap is smaller than one match's randomness, and South Africa retains only a mathematical chance.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 + 三场本土主场：墨西哥 1875（第18）对韩国 1758 / 捷克 1740 / 南非 1517，且小组赛全部在墨西哥高原进行（模型小组赛 +100 主场修正），10 万次蒙特卡洛给出 78.9% 头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap plus three home games: Mexico 1875 (#18) vs South Korea 1758 / Czechia 1740 / South Africa 1517, with every group game on Mexican altitude soil (+100 host Elo in group play), yielding a 78.9% first-place baseline over 100k Monte Carlo simulations.

key_reasons.cn: 墨西哥状态佐证基线：2026 年 8 场热身不败、仅丢 2 球，末战 5-1 塞尔维亚；仅因纯 Elo 泊松低估平局、2025 年底 6 场不胜而小幅下调 2pp。
key_reasons.en: Mexico's form supports the baseline: unbeaten in 8 friendlies in 2026 with 2 goals conceded, closing 5-1 over Serbia; only a 2pp trim for the Elo-Poisson draw underestimate and the winless run that ended 2025.

key_reasons.cn: 两支追赶者均满编但证据不足以大调：韩国孙兴慜伤愈领衔第四次世界杯（黄仁范带踝伤）；捷克 Schick 伤愈、Hložek 回归但末轮客战阿兹特克——各 +1pp。
key_reasons.en: Both challengers are at full strength but evidence supports only small shifts: Son Heung-min leads a fit Korea spine (Hwang In-beom's ankle a concern); Czechia regains Schick and Hlozek but closes away at the Azteca — +1pp each.

method_note: 100k full-tournament pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, +100 host Elo in group matches, no market input) as statistical baseline; bounded evidence adjustment of at most ±4pp per team (applied: Mexico -2pp, South Korea +1pp, Czechia +1pp, South Africa 0), net zero so the distribution sums to 1. Fully market-blind.
